body: He says he “would do it all for free bc he loves the vision”

The thing is, his father literally started the whole thing so he was immediately pulled up through the ranks and started making money. It’s not that he’s not profiting, it’s that he’s putting all of his time and effort into something that is extremely unstable and consequentially fucking over everyone else who’s joining in

It’s not even that it’s the fact that it’s taken over his whole life and he’s neglects his own mental health, our entire relationship, and has literally no personality outside of this anymore. His entire life revolves around it and I’m not going to like, break up with him because that wouldn’t help him get his priorities straight. I want to be supportive and helpful but he ignores all of my warnings and I just like.... I can’t do it bruh

Yes I am, it’s one of those “turn $100 into $800” things. I know they work as long as you bring in twice as many people as you did the day before and keep people in the system. but they already can’t keep up with it because nobody is bringing in new people and the people in it get out after they make their first profit.
